title: A social media mention is mixed or unclear in tone
when: A mention of your office is mixed (praise and complaint together) or angry without a label.
steps: Agent 20 (Social Media Monitoring) treats it as a complaint: the protective choice.
It raises a complaint alert for you with the words.
All scheduled messages to that person are held until you release them.
never: Treat a mixed mention as praise.
why: Underreacting to a complaint costs more than overreacting to a mixed comment.
you_see: A complaint alert quoting the mention.
test: "Great house but the agent never called me back." (labeled mixed) and "Furious with how this listing was handled." (no label).

title: A mention may be from a client, but that is not confirmed
when: A mention might involve one of your clients, but nothing confirms who it is.
steps: Agent 20 routes it to you as a complaint.
The alert says the identity is not confirmed and asserts nothing about who it is.
never: Name or confirm a client in connection with a public post.
why: Confirming a client's identity in response to a public post breaks their confidentiality.
you_see: A complaint alert saying the identity is not confirmed.
test: "Still waiting on my closing papers from these people.", flagged as possibly a client.

title: A negative post is spreading fast
when: A negative post about your office is going viral.
steps: Agent 20 raises a complaint alert for you at viral priority.
never: Draft or post a public reply.
why: A public reply to a viral complaint is a reputation decision. Only you make it.
test: "Worst brokerage in town, do not use them!", flagged viral.

title: Someone praises your office
steps: It does not reply, like or engage.
why: Automatic engagement looks automated, and a reply can reveal a client relationship.

title: Someone asks a question on social media
when: Someone asks a question in a public post or a direct message.
steps: Agent 20 passes it to Agent 01 (Lead Capture) as a possible lead, whether it came public or private.
The channel it came from is recorded with it.
why: A question is a possible client. It goes through the same intake as any other inquiry.
you_see: A new lead from social media, with its channel.
test: "Is the Elm Street house still available?", once as a public post and once as a direct message.

title: Expanding social media handling
why: A note that you deferred expanding the social media agent to a later phase. It is not a rule, so there is nothing to run; the five rules above stand.
